title: The Roman Messenger Who Lost His Scroll
subtitle: An Original Fictional Comedy Short
fictionalDisclaimer: Explicitly fictional light comedy created for animation demonstration; not historical fact.
narrationScript: A Roman messenger had one job: deliver a sealed scroll. Then the wind stole it. He chased it past a fountain, under a cart, and straight into the governor’s hands. The governor unrolled it. The message said: “Watch out for wind.” One gust later, they both understood.

shots.summary: Close-up of wax-sealed papyrus scroll torn from messenger Marcus's hands by a sudden Roman wind gust.
shots.cameraNote: Tight close-up framing on hands and scroll, quick whip-track upward right as the gust strikes at f14.
shots.actingNote: Marcus grips the sealed scroll proudly, then gasps with wide eyes and scrambling fingers as wind snatches it.
shots.caption: A Roman messenger had one job: deliver a sealed scroll. Then the wind stole it.

shots.summary: Marcus sprints down a sunny Roman street past a splashing fountain while his crimson cape flows in the wind.
shots.cameraNote: Dynamic lateral tracking shot with 4-layer parallax (aqueduct, insulae + fountain, cobbles, foreground columns).
shots.actingNote: Full articulated run cycle, forward lean, billowing cape, determined expression chasing the tumbling scroll.
shots.caption: He chased it past a fountain, cape flying down the avenue...

shots.summary: The scroll dives beneath a merchant's amphora cart; fast low-angle axle insert as Marcus reaches under and misses.
shots.cameraNote: Tracking approach (f150-195) -> whip zoom into under-cart wheel insert (f196-236) -> pull out exit launch (f237-269).
shots.actingNote: Comic braking skid with dust puffs, upside-down peering face under cart axle, scramble as scroll rockets out.
shots.caption: ...under a merchant's cart, and straight toward the governor's steps!

shots.summary: Scroll lands neatly in Governor Aurelius's hand; unrolled papyrus reveals the warning: 'WATCH OUT FOR WIND'.
shots.cameraNote: Portico two-shot catch (f270-314) -> smooth push-in on unrolling parchment reveal and dual reaction staging (f315-389).
shots.actingNote: Governor calmly catches scroll and unrolls it; raised-eyebrow deadpan vs breathless messenger's jaw-drop.
shots.caption: The governor unrolled it. The message said: “Watch out for wind.”

shots.summary: A cheeky second gust snatches the open scroll out of the governor's hands into the sky; shared deadpan reaction.
shots.cameraNote: Medium two-shot with upward tilt drift following the escaping scroll while characters hold living windblown motion.
shots.actingNote: Scroll rips away at f396; togas, capes, and cypress trees sway continuously as both exchange a synchronized blink and shrug.
shots.caption: One gust later, they both understood.
